Scientists report breakthrough in lab

Researchers said the result was “significant” and measured 5 mg of sample under controlled conditions. The team – based in London – published findings that reshape how clinicians think about dosage.

A spokesperson added that further trials will run through 2026, with interim data expected “within months”. Funding came from a public grant of £2 million shared across three universities.
